mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits catecholamine metabolism, potentiating clonidine's sympathomimetic effects and risking hypertensive crisis; concurrent use also increases CNS depression and serotonergic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, baseline and frequent blood pressure monitoring, and consider alternative antidepressants or antihypertensives.
